name: Design System
description: Visual component library, typography, color palette, and design tokens for Ledgerline. Serves as the canonical style reference for all application screens.

name: Login
description: Authentication page with OAuth 2.0/PKCE login flow and TOTP MFA challenge for Approver-role users. Supports error states, loading states, and session timeout re-authentication.

name: Dashboard
description: Operations Coordinator's primary view showing real-time aggregated work order counts by status, a live change detection feed, and a work orders table with filtering. This is the single-pane-of-glass overview.

name: Work Order Detail
description: Finance/AP Reviewer's primary decision-making screen showing full field-level detail for a pending work order, with Approve/Reject/Amend actions. Shows per-target-system before/after values and derivation rules.

name: Audit Trail
description: Compliance/Audit Observer's read-only interface for searching, filtering, and browsing the immutable audit trail. Supports expanding entries to see full event payloads and exporting records as JSON or CSV.

name: Sandbox Execution Log
description: IT Owner's view showing sandbox lifecycle details (created → executed → destroyed) for each executed work order, including sandbox ID, timestamps, resource limits, and retry history for failed executions.

name: Work Orders List
description: Comprehensive list view of all work orders with advanced filtering, sorting, and status indicators. Serves as the primary navigation hub for reviewers to find and act on work orders.

name: Session Timeout Warning
description: Modal overlay shown 5 minutes before session expiry, allowing users to extend or end their session. Implements the 30-minute inactivity / 8-hour absolute timeout policy.
